```{r biblioteki, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(validate)
library(naniar)
```

```{r wczytywanie i łączenie danych, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
postings <- read.csv("postings.csv")
benefits <- read.csv("benefits.csv")
employee_counts <- read.csv("employee_counts.csv")
industries <- read.csv("industries.csv")
job_industries <- read.csv("job_industries.csv")
job_skills <- read.csv("job_skills.csv")
skills <- read.csv("skills.csv")

dane <- postings %>%
  left_join(benefits, by = "job_id") %>%
  left_join(employee_counts, by = "company_id") %>%
  left_join(job_industries, by = "job_id") %>%
  left_join(industries, by = "industry_id") %>%
  left_join(job_skills, by = "job_id") %>%
  inner_join(skills, by = "skill_abr") %>%
  select(-c(original_listed_time, job_posting_url, application_url, application_type, expiry, closed_time, listed_time, posting_domain, zip_code, fips, inferred, currency, work_type, compensation_type, time_recorded, med_salary))
```

``` {r czyszczenie danych}
warunki <- validator(
  max_min_wypłaty =
    max_salary >= min_salary & min_salary >= 0,

  standaryzacja_wypłaty =
    (pay_period == "HOURLY" &
       abs(normalized_salary - ((max_salary + min_salary) / 2 * 2080)) < 0.01) |
    (pay_period == "BIWEEKLY" &
       abs(normalized_salary - ((max_salary + min_salary) / 2 * 26)) < 0.01) |
    (pay_period == "WEEKLY" &
       abs(normalized_salary - ((max_salary + min_salary) / 2 * 52)) < 0.01) |
    (pay_period == "MONTHLY" &
       abs(normalized_salary - ((max_salary + min_salary) / 2 * 12)) < 0.01) |
    (pay_period == "YEARLY" &
       abs(normalized_salary - ((max_salary + min_salary) / 2)) < 0.01) |
    max_salary == 0 | min_salary == 0 | normalized_salary == 0,
  wyświetlenia = views >= 0,
  zgłoszenia = applies >= 0,
  pracownicy = employee_count >= 0,
  obserwatorzy = follower_count >= 0
)

cf <- confront(dane, warunki)
summary(cf)
miss_var_summary(dane)


dane <- dane %>%
  replace_na(list(remote_allowed = 0))
```
